measurement_scope: Lite write-amplification counting harness (zig build lite-write-amplification, Debug), extended with dense_vector/sparse_vector modes for WS0-for-vectors. Operation counts (durable syncs, write/pwrite calls and bytes, durable commits), not timing. dense_vector/dense_vector_8_writers and sparse_vector/sparse_vector_8_writers are single-doc-per-transaction writes with caller-supplied vectors through an external:true dense_vector/sparse_vector index's _embeddings field (no embedding inference on the write path), acked at sync_level=full_index (the sync level requiring this write's own vector-index publication to be visible before batch() returns). 128 updates total (8-writer modes: 16 per writer, barrier-synchronized). This is the BEFORE measurement: dense_storage_backend and sparse_backend are still .lsm (LSM-on-Lite's-virtual-filesystem, lite/index_storage.zig), matching full-text's own pre-WS4 shape.
known_limitations: Measured with dense_dims=128, sparse_terms=32 (see the embedded report); not the SQLite-comparison harness's workload shape, so not directly comparable to primary_only/indexed's text_bytes=1024 numbers except by order of magnitude.

dense_vector and sparse_vector each run against a fresh index with no existing vectors, so HBC/sparse's own background maintenance (graph rebuild, posting-chunk compaction) never triggers during this short run; background_syncs_per_update for these two modes reflects only ordinary catch-up/maintenance turns, not compaction.

main_txn_commit reads zero for both vector modes in this run: the native_catalog_backend.zig stage-tag addition in this same change (NamespaceTxn.commit) is present but inert while dense_storage_backend/sparse_backend still select .lsm; their LSM-WAL commits are attributed through the shared vfs_write/vfs_append/vfs_sync/vfs_finish/artifact_lease stages instead (same shared VFS code full-text's own pre-WS4 .lsm path used).
